name: Manuscript miniature
material: tempera/ink and often gold on parchment or vellum; exact conventions vary by manuscript culture and century
fabrication_process: prepare grounds for gilding when used
edge_behavior: Fine controlled edges and ornament; page boundaries and text-image relationships matter more than photographic depth.
color_behavior: Rich local colors with gold accents; parchment warmth remains visible; spatial modeling varies by school and period.
surface_behavior: Parchment has fine skin texture/translucency and can cockle; gold reflects sharply and differently from paint.
composition_behavior: Compose for a page: miniature field, margins, initials/borders and text blocks form one designed object.
structural_limitations: do not use generic “medieval” conventions across Byzantine/French/Italian/etc. without culture
text must be verified or kept decorative/non-readable by design
aging_weathering: abrasion, pigment loss, trimmed edges, handling grime and gold wear are state-specific

prompt_fragments.core: Design a real manuscript page: bounded miniature field, parchment margins, controlled tempera detail and physically reflective gold, with text/border hierarchy planned before ornament.

typical_generation_failures: fantasy digital painting pasted on parchment
evaluation_criteria: cultural/period convention is specified when historical

sources.supports: tempera and gold leaf on parchment and miniature/page layout

scope_note: This module controls material/production behavior. It does not select an era by itself.
